A '''flanth-house''' was a type of [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] that specialized in serving [[Flangth|flanth]]. The [[Grass Hutt]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] was the ritziest flanth-house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
